name: Balloon Fair
summary: Hot-air balloons at a dawn fair: burn to climb, vent to sink and ride the winds onto the target
about: A balloon festival at sunrise over mountains and rolling hills, where the crew fills a new balloon with cold air, stands it up with the burner and lets it go. Like real pilots, you steer only by height: three wind layers blow east, west and east again, shown by streaks and little wind pills, so you climb or sink to catch the one that carries you onto the white cross. Good for a travel or events page, a kids' game or a calm sunrise hero.
how: Hold Burner (or press on the sky, or hold Space) to heat the envelope: it glows, then slowly climbs.
Hold Vent (or the down arrow) to let hot air out and sink; the balloon drifts with the wind at its height.
Land softly on the white cross for a bullseye, confetti and a cheering crowd; a hard landing bounces.
Press Launch to inflate a new balloon on the field, and tap a balloon or press Next balloon to fly another.
The sun rises as you play; dark mode starts before dawn, and reduced motion keeps everything with less sway.
